name: @pipeworx/mcp-leetcode

tools.name: user_profile
tools.description: Fetch a LeetCode user's public profile by username via GraphQL; returns real name, bio, avatar, global ranking, country, company, school, and star rating.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-leetcode forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the leetcode pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
